fact: INSA's Director General said the House of People's Representatives unanimously ratified Critical Infrastructure Cybersecurity Proclamation No. 1426/2026, which sets 18 obligations for owners of 12 critical sectors, and that institutions are to use a transition period to prepare for compliance, so it is passed and not yet shown in force; the document gives no ratification date, so the date is its publication date, 2026-08-07.

The Federal Negarit Gazette 32nd Year No. 41 carries Critical Infrastructure Cyber Security Protection Proclamation No. 1426/2026, done at Addis Ababa on 21 July 2026 and signed by the President, and its article 28 provides that it enters into force one year after publication, so it is passed and not yet in force (commencement July 2027).
